SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF DEC-05-2023 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF DEC-05-2023 BY JUDGE PRO TEM PANG LY. PLAINTIFF KAREN ALEXI OLIVARES IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT NORLAN FRANCISCO RIVERA QUINTANILLA IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT / MINOR MONICA BOJORQUEZ MARTINEZ IS PRESENT WITH HER MOTHER ROSA PATRICA MARTINEZ. ALL PARTIES PRESENT WERE ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED SPANISH INTERPRETER DANIEL NAVARRO CSR# 300802. PARTIES WERE UNABLE TO COME TO A SETTLEMENT DURING RECESS. HONORABLE PANG LY ALLOWS THE PLAINTIFF TO AMEND THE CLAIM IN COURT TO ADD ROSA PATRICA MARTINEZ AS A DEFENDANT. ROSA PATRICA MARTINEZ WAIVES SERVICE TO BE HEARD IN COURT TODAY. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: PANG LY; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-05-2023 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF OLIVARES VELAZQUEZ, KAREN ALEXI RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT RIVERA QUINTANILLA, NORLAN FRANCISCO MARTINEZ, ROSA PATRICIA $7,276.08 PRINCIPAL, $75.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $7,351.08, THE COURT AMENDED COMPLAINT TO ADD DEFENDANT ROSA PATRICIA MARTINEZ AND SAID DEFENDANT WAIVED NOTICE TO PROCEED WITH THE HEARING. DEFENDANT RIVERA QUINTANILLA AND DEFENDANT ROSA MARTINEZ SHALL PAY PLAINTIFF AS FOLLOWS: RIVERA QUINTANILLA $3,638.04 AND ROSA MARTINEZ $2,338.04 GIVEN CREDIT FOR $1,300 PREVIOUSLY PAID. RIVERA QUINTANILLA & ROSA MARTINEZ SHALL ALSO PAY TO THE COURT $37.50 EACH FOR COSTS AS PLAINTIFF WAS GIVEN A FEE WAIVER. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
REMARK:RETURNED MAIL BY THE POST OFFICE. DEC 19 2023. NOTICE OF ENTRY OF JUDGEMENT MAILED TO DEFENDANT. (ENVELOPE MARKED RETURN TO SENDER ATTEMPTED - NOT KNOWN UNABLE TO FORWARD)
